principle: Assign one primary category according to the dominant actual delivery role, not every advertised capability.
publication_requirements: Every published company must have exactly one valid primary category.
Uncategorised is a temporary intake state and is not publishable.
Use verified data-center evidence when available.
When specific data-center evidence is unavailable, classify the company's verified general offering.
Escalate for human review only when two plausible categories remain tied.
evidence_priority: Confirmed responsibility in a Finnish data-center project
Official company description of its data-center offering
Reliable project announcement or customer reference
Official description of the company's general offering

family_sequence.question: Does the company own or operate data-center facilities or computing campuses?
Is the dominant role constructing facilities, infrastructure or permanently installed technical systems?
Is the dominant role site development, independent design, engineering or project management?
Is the dominant role manufacturing or supplying equipment, products or software?
Is the dominant role operational, commercial or professional support?

tie_breakers: Overall project responsibility takes priority over technical specialization.
External grid and substation construction takes priority over general electrical installation.
Civil and site work takes priority over industrial construction when it is the dominant activity.
A clearly dominant specialist trade takes priority over multidisciplinary technical installation.
Manufacturing or supplying a product takes priority over installation when the product is the dominant offering.
Independent advice, design or verification takes priority over construction when the company does not execute the work.
Use an Other category only after testing every specific category in that family.

rules.question: Does the company own or operate facilities providing data-center or dedicated computing capacity?
Is power equipment the company's dominant supplied product?
Is cooling, ventilation, liquid handling or heat-recovery equipment the dominant supplied product?
Is computing, storage, rack, cabling or internal network equipment the dominant supplied product?
Is monitoring, control, sensing or operational software the dominant supplied product?
Are physical or digital security products the dominant supplied offering?
Are building materials, components or prefabricated products the dominant supplied offering?
excludes: On-site construction as the dominant role

rules.question: Is the company primarily a technology supplier not covered by another technology category?
Does verified evidence confirm overall responsibility for a complete Finnish data-center building or major construction phase?
excludes: Marketing capability without a confirmed Finnish project

rules.question: Does the company construct industrial facilities or structural packages without confirmed overall data-center responsibility?
Are earthworks, rock works, foundations, roads, drainage or underground site utilities dominant?
Is external power infrastructure construction the dominant role?
Does the company primarily install, integrate or commission technical systems inside or directly serving facilities?
Is fire protection clearly the company's dominant construction activity?
Are roofing, façades, cladding, insulation, waterproofing or weather protection dominant?
excludes: Supply of building products without installation

rules.question: Does the company perform construction work not covered by another construction category?
excludes: Any role matching a more specific construction category

rules.question: Is developing land, sites, power access or permits for future facilities the dominant role?
Is a public or regional organization enabling investment and local business development?
Is independent architecture, engineering or technical design the dominant role?
excludes: Independent project management as the dominant role

rules.question: Is independent project management, supervision, coordination, quality or safety oversight dominant?
Is electricity, fuel or energy-market service the dominant offering?
Are external telecommunications or fibre connectivity services the dominant offering?
Is independent commissioning, testing or performance verification the dominant offering?
excludes: Commissioning performed only as part of installation

rules.question: Is operating or maintaining complete facilities and building systems the dominant offering?
Are guarding, security operations or ongoing protection services the dominant offering?
Are equipment repair, refurbishment, relocation or retirement services dominant?
Are transport, forwarding, storage or equipment-delivery services dominant?
Are recruitment, workforce supply or employment services dominant?
Is legal, financial, property, investment, communications or management advice dominant?
Is the company primarily a service provider not covered by another service category?
excludes: Any service matching a more specific category
